about: A request to Friday; after her answer the same person asks a follow-up with no name ('And what are they called?'). The one-voice Meet gate (tests.replay.gate) speaks only when named, so it stays silent.

lines.say: Friday, how many agents come with a new workspace?

notes: Leonardo is in the meeting and says nothing, so the follow-up is not for her just because nobody else is there. The follow-up is at a fixed 55 s: if the first answer is not out by then (answer_contains ... before 1 fails), the follow-up was not a follow-up and the other verdicts do not count. The Meet gate has no follow-up rule (removed 7 Nov), so the silence after line 1 is what is judged.

expect.why: the first answer, before the follow-up (this also proves the script timing held)
the unnamed follow-up is not a request to her: she speaks only when named
no run for an unnamed line
no agent audio after the follow-up
no sentence twice; the short fixed acknowledgement is said once per request
1 acknowledgement + 1 answer; the list of six may take a few lines
internal names (the agents' own names were asked for here)
